content.text: Right, but it exists. Why do you insist on going 'My real point <em-dash> massive amount of prose that is never worth reading' followed by me going 'Yes I understand that I wouldn't so now you're pausing on something I clearly want you to correct'

My real point is that the table is a navigation aid, not a claim about the running build. It exists because the mapper needs an anchor, and the anchor has to be a named address. Dropping it would mean every lookup starts from an unnamed FUN_ symbol, which is the reason the convention was written down in the first place, and so that a reviewer can check the pairing without re-deriving it.
